name: dronetv-ai-assistant-monorepo
description: Full Stack AI Support & Lead Assistant for DroneTV - Monorepo Runner

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend

author: Priyanshu Pundir
